parsed.rationale: Post-release analytics dashboard load time increased to 30–45 seconds (previously <5s), causing daily planning delays for 25 operations users; this indicates a performance/latency regression likely owned by engineering.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. We understand that after the last release the analytics dashboard now takes about 30–45 seconds to load (previously under 5 seconds), and this is slowing daily planning for 25 operations users. 

Because this is a significant post-release performance change, we’re treating it as a performance regression investigation. To help us pinpoint what changed, could you share the release date/version number (or the exact build identifier) and whether the slowness is consistent for all users and all browsers, or only certain users/locations?

If you’re able, please also provide the approximate time window when users notice the delay and any relevant dashboard URL/module they’re landing on (e.g., specific report page), so we can compare load behavior across environments. 

Once we have those details, our team will investigate the issue and work toward a resolution; we’ll follow up with next steps as we learn more.
promised_actions: Investigate the reported post-release performance change
Follow up with next steps once additional details are received

The app eventually loads even though it is slow.

Ongoing operational disruption during daily planning for 25 users.
